withheld.name: Hodgdon Trail Boss
withheld.note: The fit does not describe it (WS426, WS446): its 23 measured pressures read 17.8% off at the median against 2.4-5.9% for 2400, H110, N110 and Varget, and its velocities 3.8% against 0.7-1.4%. The burn rate is not the cause: the fitted rate is the one at which its measured pressures sit level, and its 33 loads lie in 33 cartridge-bullet groups, so the error is load to load and no rate removes it. GRT has no model of it. Left out of the cartridge view and the Powder Optimizer until the fit describes it.

withheld.name: Norma 217
withheld.note: Its fitted burn rate is 1.67x off GRT's trend (post_calibrate section H), and by the engine's time to 90% burnt it ranks 3rd fastest of 91 in 300 Win Mag, where the manuals' charges put it among the slowest (120 against IMR 4350's 100). Its own loads pick the fitted rate (WS446): at the trend's rate its energy would have to be 1.39x the record's, and 1.21x on GRT's own 3,660 kJ/kg, and its measured pressures would read 26% low. So the engine fits it as a low-energy, fast-burning powder that its loads support and the manuals' order contradicts. Left out of the cartridge view and the Powder Optimizer until that is explained.
